findings.description: V32 current sit/crouch images and sit thigh transects reject anterior coverage. At 52% along each evaluated UpperLeg bone, the current lap panels are posterior to the shorts (Blender anterior is negative Y): left lap median Y -0.0972 m vs left shorts -0.1606 m (63 mm posterior); right lap -0.1219 m vs right shorts -0.1616 m (40 mm posterior). Current measured coverage remains sit 0.2316/0.2237 and crouch 0.3514/0.3695 for the overskirt, versus 0.9548/0.9548 and 0.9537/0.9537 for shorts. The source-bound transect identifies the panel trajectory and nearest projections to the declared UpperLeg-weighted body triangle set; it does not establish fit acceptance.

Direct V32 front, sit, crouch and side renders show coarse triangular faceting, uneven split front edges, abrupt hem transitions, and narrow pointed tips. The attachment change moves front edges slightly without resolving visual continuity.
Direct inspection of current V32 rear render finds no clearly readable adjustment-tab or buckle silhouette; it remains visually merged with the garment and has no dedicated rear close-up.
Current V32 weighted prototype still has no authored UV map. UV remains MISSING; no substitute UV has been generated.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V32 is rejected. Current direct preview renders and source-bound sit-thigh transects show the front-lap panels remain posterior to the shorts by median 63 mm left and 40 mm right; measured sit coverage is 0.2316/0.2237 and crouch 0.3514/0.3695, versus about 0.955 shorts coverage. The current renders remain visibly faceted with pointed, uneven edges; the rear tab is not legible. UV remains MISSING. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime and release remain unverified.

meshShowcase.boundary: Base garment edges in neutral coordinates, not evaluated deformation or a topology/UV quality pass. Avatar meshes excluded by explicit garment role.

sitThighTransects.boundary: Sections are evaluated sit-pose intersections perpendicular to each UpperLeg bone at 52% of bone length. In Blender coordinates anterior is negative Y; compare panel and shorts section Y ranges, but visual overlap is not a fit pass. Red and blue points/lines show selected lap-panel vertices projected to triangles on the posed avatar surface whose corresponding thigh skin-weight mean is at least 0.20. This local diagnostic grants no fit, appearance, or release acceptance.

nextAction: Do not start another parameter sweep. Use this cross-section evidence to change the source of the front-lap trajectory itself: draft the anterior lap panels to follow the seated thigh surface and connect them smoothly into the adjacent front skirt panels, then re-run the normal build, pose coverage and render gates. Inspect sit and crouch directly. Keep the rejection, UV, fit, runtime, Shape Key, package and release gates.
